html:
Architecture Services

Designing Spaces That Inspire, Innovate, and Transform

Architecture done properly begins long before anything is drawn. We start with the site, the orientation, the brief and the way the building will actually be used, then shape structure and form around those facts. Our practice spans residential, commercial and institutional work, carrying a project from first concept sketches through construction drawings and on-site supervision.

Our Architectural Philosophy

"We believe architecture is more than just construction—it’s about creating experiences. Every project begins with understanding your needs, site context, and aspirations. Our designs prioritize functionality, aesthetics, and sustainability, resulting in spaces that are beautiful, practical, and environmentally responsible."

Residential & Commercial Architecture

From modern villas to cozy homes, we design personalized Residential Architecture that balances comfort, style, and functionality. We also create Commercial & Office Architecture with efficient layouts to enhance productivity and client experience.

Retail & Landscape Architecture

We strategically design Retail & Showroom Architecture to highlight products and engage customers. Our Landscape Architecture services create beautiful outdoor spaces, including gardens, terraces, and recreational areas that harmonize with nature.

Interior Architecture & Visualization

We offer Interior Architecture, seamlessly integrating interiors with structural design for cohesive, elegant spaces. This is supported by detailed 3D Modeling & Visualization to help clients visualize the final outcome.

Key Design Principles

Our projects feature Sustainable & Innovative Design, using eco-friendly materials and energy-efficient solutions. We apply Optimal Space Planning and precise execution to ensure enduring beauty, utility, and value.

How Our Architecture Services Work

A building is the one part of a project you cannot easily change later. That is why our architecture services put most of the effort into the early stages, when moving a wall or turning a staircase costs nothing more than a revised drawing. Over 22 years and more than 800 completed spaces, our architects and interior designers have refined a sequence that keeps decisions in the right order.

Site analysis and brief

We study the plot, its orientation, the local building rules, access, neighbouring structures and the way sun and wind move across the site. Alongside this, we write a brief with you: how many people will use the building, what each floor needs to hold, and how the property should grow over the next decade.

Concept design

Massing studies and plan options show different ways the brief could fit on the site. We compare them on light, privacy, circulation, cost and how well they connect indoors and outdoors, and then develop the strongest option with you.

3D visualisation

Photorealistic 3D views and walkthroughs make the design easy to understand before construction. Elevations, façade materials and interior volumes can all be reviewed and adjusted while change is still cheap.

Working drawings and coordination

Our architecture services include the detailed drawings a contractor builds from, coordinated with structural, electrical and plumbing requirements so that beams, ducts and points do not clash on site.

Site supervision

During construction, we visit the site at key stages to check that the work matches the drawings and to resolve questions quickly, so small issues do not become expensive rework.

Architecture and Interiors Under One Roof

Many problems in finished buildings come from architects and interior designers working separately. A column lands in the middle of a wardrobe wall, or a window sits where the bed needs to go. Because our team handles both, interior layouts are considered while the building is still being drawn. Ceiling heights, window positions and electrical points are planned around the furniture you will actually use. If interiors are your main concern, our interior design services page explains that side of the work.

Projects We Take On

  • Homes and villas: independent houses, builder floors and large family residences, including farmhouses on the edge of the city.
  • Commercial buildings: offices, showrooms and mixed-use buildings where frontage, signage and customer flow matter.
  • Hospitality and wellness: salons, spas and similar spaces where the layout directly affects how a business runs.
  • Renovations and extensions: reworking an existing structure to suit how a family or business uses it today.

Designing for Comfort and Long Life

Good architecture keeps working long after handover. We orient rooms to bring in daylight while limiting harsh afternoon sun, plan cross-ventilation where the site allows, and choose durable façade and roofing materials that age well. These choices lower running costs and make a building more pleasant to live or work in every day. Where clients want it, Vastu principles are considered alongside planning and structure, not added as an afterthought.

Budget, Timelines and Accountability

Our pricing is transparent and broken into clear milestones, with no hidden costs. Fixed timelines and a 10-year warranty on our work give you a firm basis for planning. You always know which stage the project is at and what comes next.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do your architecture services cover interiors too?

Yes. Our architecture services and interior design are handled by one team, so the building and its interiors are planned together.

Can you work on an existing building?

Yes. Renovation is part of our work, from re-planning the inside of an existing home or commercial building to designing extensions.

Talk to Our Architects

Our head office is in Pitampura, Delhi, with a branch in Gurgaon, and we provide architecture services across Delhi NCR and Karnal. Book a free consultation to discuss your plot or building, or explore our completed projects to see how our architecture services shape the finished result.

Why Choose Our Architecture Services

  • Experienced Architects
  • Customized Solutions
  • Sustainable & Innovative Design
  • End-to-End Project Management

Build something that lasts. Partner with us for architecture that resolves function, structure and beauty in a single design - a building that works as well in its tenth year as it did in its first.
